Package neqsim.thermo.characterization

Class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterStackLossBalance

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermo.characterization.RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterStackLossBalance
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RefineryHydrotreatingSulfurNitrogenFiredHeaterStackLossBalance extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable caller-scenario stack sensible-loss receipt for coupled sulfur/nitrogen hydrotreating.

The receipt combines a qualified wet flue-gas molar flow with caller-owned stack and reference temperatures and a caller-owned mean wet-flue-gas molar heat capacity. It reconciles the resulting sensible stack loss to the furnace loss already qualified by the upstream utility receipt. It does not calculate heat capacity, heat transfer, or equipment performance.

Version:
1.0

esolbr1

      Calculate caller-owned wet-flue-gas sensible loss and reconcile it to total furnace loss.
      Parameters:
      combustionBalance - qualified complete-combustion receipt
      stackGasTemperatureKelvin - caller-supplied wet-flue-gas stack temperature in K
      referenceTemperatureKelvin - caller-supplied sensible-enthalpy reference temperature in K
      meanWetFlueGasMolarHeatCapacityKiloJoulePerKmolKelvin - caller-supplied mean wet-flue-gas molar heat capacity between the reference and stack temperatures in kJ/(kmol K)
      Returns:
      immutable stack sensible-loss receipt
